# Payment Failure Runbook

## Purpose

This runbook helps resolve payment failures and credit card declines.

## Allowed

- Instruct customers to update billing info in settings.
- Suggest retrying the transaction or contacting their card issuer.
- Explain common decline codes (e.g., insufficient funds).

## Restricted

- Do not manually collect credit card numbers in chat/email.
- Do not process payments over unsecured communication channels.

## Escalation

Escalate to billing ops if system-wide gateway errors occur.

# Service Credit Policy

## Purpose

This policy handles requests for billing credit due to system downtime.

## Allowed

- Explain the calculation: credits are proportional to downtime duration.
- Inform customers that credits will be applied to the next bill.

## Restricted

- Do not issue credits exceeding one month of subscription fees.
- Do not issue cash or bank-wire refunds for downtime.

## Escalation

Escalate validation of downtime claims to the DevOps and Finance Leads.
